text:
ravi: FYI deploybot kicked off `matmul-opt-q8-1.2+abi12` canary in eu-central-1 during the quiet window. telemetry shows a steady p95 rise and a handful of nvml thermal warnings. thinking temporary pin + headroom repro.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout started for bundle matmul-opt-q8-1.2+abi12 (canary slice: 18 hosts) in eu-central-1. Use `deploybot status 1768802468`.

sre-bot: quick snapshot: p95 +14% vs baseline, error-rate 0.4% -> 0.9% on canary hosts. nvml logs show intermittent temp spikes and short throttle events on 3 hosts. dashboard: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1768802468

alexa: can someone paste the host tail? want to know if we're hitting a new kernel path or just higher SM utilization.

ravi: tail from ec1-canary-05:
```
[2026-03-18T09:42:11Z] runtime: matmul_q8 dispatch=tiling_hybrid
[2026-03-18T09:42:12Z] nvml: temp rise 75C -> 88C (2s)
[2026-03-18T09:42:13Z] runtime: power_draw=310W sm_util=95.3%
[2026-03-18T09:42:14Z] runtime: tail_latency p95=285ms model=matmul-opt-q8-1.2
```

jules: looks like tiling_hybrid increases sustained power. We should avoid wider rollout until we repro. propose: 1) set pin TTL=90m 2) pause region expansion 3) run headroom repro with `stress_matmul --tiling tiling_hybrid --seq 1024 --duration 8m` on a staging node 4) if repro matches, ops to try lowering power caps/fan curve for canary and re-run.

ops_maya: I can run repro and also temporarily set power cap on canary racks. prefer pin TTL 60-90m. Also want a short rollback criterion: if p95 stays +10% for 10m or errors >1% sustained -> rollback to matmul-opt-q8-1.1.

alexa: +1 to repro-first. mj: also suggest short canary throttle to 2% traffic to limit blast radius.

ravi: agreed. Action items: @deploybot reduce pin TTL to 90m and pause expansion. @ops_maya run repro and attempt powercap=280W if repro matches. @sre-bot file anomaly ticket and attach nvml and canary traces.

deploybot: UPDATE: Pin TTL set to 90m by ravi. Rollout paused in eu-central-1.

sre-bot: ticket RED-3582 created: "eu-central matmul-opt-q8-1.2 canary: thermal headroom regressions". attaching traces.

ops_maya: repro started on staging-ml-04. early nvml snapshot: sm_util ~96%, power ~318W, temp spike to 89C within 90s.

jules: repro matches. ops, please apply power cap to canary racks and restart canary slice. If p95 improves to within +5% and no throttle events -> we can consider a gated reattempt with power gating or fan profile change.

ops_maya: applied power cap 280W to two canary racks and restarted canary hosts. new run p95 ~160ms, temps peak ~82C, no throttle in last 6m.

alexa: good signal. short-term mitigation validated. Long-term: engineering should add a host-power-check in preflight and an adaptive tiling fallback when power headroom is low.

ravi: agreed. Release notes blurb: "HOLD: matmul-opt-q8-1.2 paused in eu-central-1 due to increased sustained GPU power on some hardware; mitigation via limited power cap validated. Reattempt gated after driver/tiling follow-up." I'll update RN and ping product.

sre-bot: RED-3582 updated with mitigation and next steps. Closing for now; will reopen if new spikes.

ops_maya: rolling back caps in 60m unless we get approval to keep them during the re-roll.

ravi: keep caps for the reattempt window. thanks team. :thumbsup:
